subject.title: System prompt should prefer Skill tool over read when available

question: May a plugin-provided loader replace direct SKILL.md reads, and what typed capability and trust requirements must identify that loader across native and Codex harnesses?
rationale: This changes instruction authority and plugin trust; Pi’s generic tool API and Codex’s typed native skill protocol do not establish that an arbitrary same-named tool is safe or equivalent.

options.title: Typed loader capability
options.body: Add trusted capability metadata and render loader-owned guidance consistently across native and Codex harnesses.

options.title: Reserve Skill name
options.body: Treat a normalized `Skill` tool name as privileged and document collision, provenance, and trust rules.

options.title: Retain direct reads
options.body: Keep core’s read-based contract and let extensions use existing tool-owned prompt guidance without claiming binding authority.

recommendation.title: Typed loader capability
recommendation.body: Add trusted capability metadata and render loader-owned guidance consistently across native and Codex harnesses.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider-owned prompt contribution and plugin-boundary work is the closest history match for deciding a cross-plugin prompt capability.
